title: outrageous Ukrainian vegetable Borscht
description: A hearty, umami-rich vegetable borscht perfect for a crowd, made with vegetable stock and topped with a tangy beurre-monte. This recipe is free from nuts and perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Combine beets, carrots, cabbage, onion, and garlic in a large pot.
Add vegetable stock and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Add tomato paste and apple cider vinegar, and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
To make the beurre-monte, whip softened butter and sour cream together until smooth and doubled in volume, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
To serve, ladle the borscht into bowls and top with a dollop of beurre-monte and a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill.
Optional: serve with a side of crusty rye bread or boiled potatoes.
